description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application, managing user state, token authentication, and related functions like login and logout.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component providing authentication context to children, managing user state and token lifecycle.

methods.name: fetchUser
methods.description: Fetches user data from the server using the stored token, updates user state.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Stores token, sets authorization header, and fetches user data upon login.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears token and user data, removes authorization header, and logs out user.
